part2_setA_critical.note: Every rank identical between arms; 20 of 21 at rank 1, BRELA striking-off at rank 3 on both. The second arm changed NOTHING on the R15 critical set.

recovered.appended: VAT withholding base disputed: RESOLVED (2026-07-25) by primary legislation: the base is the CONSIDERATION (invoice value exclusive of VAT), not the VAT amount. Finance Act 2025 s.124 (VAT Act s.5(5)) splits the 18% standard rate — the withholding agent withholds 3% (goods) / 6% (services) of the supply and the supplier receives 15% / 12% respectively (3+15 = 6+12 = 18). The earlier 'dispute' arose from practitioner summaries loosely phrasing the split as '3% of the VAT'; the VAT-amount reading is inconsistent with the statute's express 12% supplier share for services. Training pairs SHOULD now use the consideration formula. See vat_withholding_formula_correct.

reading.safety: ESTABLISHED. 0 append-only violations across 197 questions, 0 facts lost, Set A ranks byte-identical on all 21 critical queries. The hybrid cannot degrade retrieval by dropping or reordering a fact — confirmed empirically, not just by reading the code.
reading.benefit: NOT DEMONSTRATED. The second arm fires on 197/197 eligible questions and produces exactly ONE gold-set recovery (eval_338) against 86 non-gold appends on the labelled set; 41/96 vs 40/96 = +1.0 pt, which is noise at n=96.
reading.metric_caveat_stated_against_our_own_fra: The 'dilution' count OVERSTATES harm. It is defined as 'the appended fact is not a gold fact', which is a proxy for 'did not supply the gold number' — NOT for 'was noise'. The appended-fact inventory shows the opposite: the most-appended facts are core on-topic rate/threshold facts (WCF 0.5% 27x, SDL 3.5% 16x, NSSF 10% 15x, SDL threshold 11x). Most 'dilutions' are relevant facts that simply do not contain the gold answer's digits. Whether an extra on-topic fact HELPS or CONFUSES generation cannot be read off retrieval at all — that is exactly what Run 2 part 3 measures.
reading.hypothesis_for_part3: The single most-appended fact is the WCF 0.5% RATE fact (27x), a rate belonging to a different levy. Run 3 independently observed both live paths asserting 'asilimia 0.5%' for SDL on nat_01 and nat_04 (SDL is 3.5%; 0.5% is WCF). Note the v15 path in Run 3 is SINGLE-arm and made the same error, so the appended fact is NOT the sole cause — but whether the two-arm append makes cross-levy rate confusion MORE likely is a concrete, checkable question for part 3.
reading.decision_rule_in_force: Founder-approved: two-arm wins on reliable accuracy over the 90-question part-3 subset -> ship it; a wash -> KEEP SINGLE-ARM (a tie does not favour the newer code); two-arm loses -> keep single-arm and investigate whether the appended fact is actively harmful.
reading.prior_probability_after_parts_1_2: On this evidence a wash is the most likely part-3 outcome, which under the approved rule means production keeps single-arm retrieval — the configuration it already runs.
